name: FeedBlitz
line: Send newsletters and automated campaigns, with a transactional email API.

free.text: 30-day trial; no ongoing free plan listed

cells.api: Yes, REST; transactional API on Accel/Enterprise

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 4,000 recipient emails a month. Core costs $29 a month.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 20,000 recipient emails a month. Core costs $49 a month.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 40,000 recipient emails a month. Core costs $69 a month.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns = 200,000 recipient emails a month. Core costs $299 a month.

appmail.math: 3,000 messages, with 1,000 billable recipients assumed. The Accel base price for subscribers is $35, plus any partner or license charge and tax, so this is not an exact quote.
